observation.command:
python -c "
from matminer.featurizers.composition import ElementFraction
from pymatgen.core import Composition
ef = ElementFraction()
c = Composition('BN')
res = ef.featurize(c)
print('Length:', len(res))
print('Type of res[0]:', type(res[0]))
print('Value of res[0] (first 10):', res[0][:10] if hasattr(res[0], '__len__') else res[0])
# Check feature labels
print('Feature labels:', ef.feature_labels()[:10])
"
